about: The traditional seasonal calendar used in Kuwait and across the Gulf: 14 seasons over 365 days, starting with the rising of Suhail on 24 August. Each season ends the day before the next one starts, so leap days fall inside Al-Aqarib.

seasons.note_ar: طلع سهيل فبرد الليل وبدا الحر ينكسر شوي شوي.
seasons.note_en: Suhail has risen, the nights cool and the heat slowly breaks.
seasons.hint_ar: نظّف المزاريب وبدّل المساحات قبل أول مطرة.
seasons.hint_en: Clear the drains and replace the wipers before the first rain.

seasons.note_en: The first rains and the best weather of the year.
seasons.hint_ar: افحص المكيفات بعد القيظ، ونظّف السخان قبل البرد.
seasons.hint_en: Check the ACs after summer, and flush the water heater before the cold.

seasons.note_en: Forty days of the hardest cold.
seasons.hint_ar: انتبه لخرطوم الغاز والدفايات، والسخان شغال طول الوقت.
seasons.hint_en: Mind the gas hose and the heaters, the water heater runs all day.

seasons.note_en: A damp cold that gets into your bones.
seasons.hint_en: Watch for damp and leaks after the rains.

seasons.note_en: The last of the cold, and its mood swings.
seasons.hint_ar: وقت زين لرش الحشرات قبل ما يدفى الجو.
seasons.hint_en: A good time for pest control before it warms up.

seasons.hint_ar: احجز غسيل المكيفات قبل لا ينشغل الفنيين.
seasons.hint_en: Book the AC wash before the technicians get busy.

seasons.note_en: Late spring, and the heat is knocking.
seasons.hint_en: Check the car AC and the coolant.

seasons.note_en: The heat begins and the Pleiades hide.
seasons.hint_ar: البطارية والتواير قبل الحر، وعوازل الدرايش قبل البوارح.
seasons.hint_en: Battery and tires before the heat, window seals before the Bawarih.

seasons.note_en: The first Bawarih winds and the first dust.
seasons.hint_ar: بدت البوارح، فنظّف فلاتر المكيفات كل أسبوعين.
seasons.hint_en: The Bawarih have begun, so clean the AC filters every two weeks.

seasons.hint_ar: افحص ضغط التواير الصبح والتواير باردة.
seasons.hint_en: Check tire pressure in the morning while the tires are cold.

seasons.hint_ar: لا تخلي السيارة بالشمس، وراقب حرارة المكينة.
seasons.hint_en: Keep the car out of the sun and watch the engine temperature.

seasons.note_en: The last of the Bawarih winds.
seasons.hint_ar: قبل سفرة الصيف، مر على قائمة السفر.
seasons.hint_en: Before the summer trip, go through the travel checklist.

seasons.note_en: The very peak of summer heat.
seasons.hint_ar: راجع المكيفات أول ما تحس إن التبريد ضعف.
seasons.hint_en: Check the ACs as soon as the cooling feels weaker.

seasons.note_ar: حر ورطوبة عالية قبل طلعة سهيل.
seasons.note_en: Heat and heavy humidity before Suhail rises.
seasons.hint_ar: الرطوبة عالية، فشيّك تصريف المكيفات والتسريبات.
seasons.hint_en: Humidity is high, so check the AC drains and look for leaks.
